questions.question:
Identify the sentence that correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial clause.

A. Only after the rain stopped did they begin to clean the garden.
B. Only after the rain stopped they began to clean the garden.
C. Only after the rain stopped, they began to clean the garden.
D. Only after the rain stopped, did they began to clean the garden.
options: Only after the rain stopped did they begin to clean the garden.
Only after the rain stopped they began to clean the garden.
Only after the rain stopped, they began to clean the garden.
Only after the rain stopped, did they began to clean the garden.
questions.answer: Only after the rain stopped did they begin to clean the garden.

questions.question:
Which of the following sentences correctly employs a cleft sentence to highlight the location?

A. It was in the old library that the historian discovered the rare manuscript.
B. It was the old library that the historian discovered the rare manuscript.
C. It was in the old library where the historian discovered the rare manuscript.
D. It was the old library in which the historian discovered the rare manuscript.
options: It was in the old library that the historian discovered the rare manuscript.
It was the old library that the historian discovered the rare manuscript.
It was in the old library where the historian discovered the rare manuscript.
It was the old library in which the historian discovered the rare manuscript.
questions.answer: It was in the old library that the historian discovered the rare manuscript.

questions.question:
Select the option that correctly uses the subjunctive mood in the given context.

If only I ________ the opportunity, I would have studied abroad last year.

A. had been given
B. was given
C. were given
D. should be given
options: had been given
was given
were given
should be given

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses ellipsis to maintain grammatical parallelism?

A. She enjoys reading novels, and he enjoys playing tennis.
B. She enjoys reading novels, and he does tennis playing.
C. She enjoys reading novels, and he enjoys tennis playing.
D. She enjoys reading novels, and he does enjoy tennis playing.
options: She enjoys reading novels, and he enjoys playing tennis.
She enjoys reading novels, and he does tennis playing.
She enjoys reading novels, and he enjoys tennis playing.
She enjoys reading novels, and he does enjoy tennis playing.
questions.answer: She enjoys reading novels, and he enjoys playing tennis.

questions.question:
Identify the sentence that appropriately uses formal register and complex sentence structure.

A. Due to the recent economic downturn, businesses have had to lay off employees, which has led to an increase in unemployment claims.
B. Because of the economic downturn, businesses laid off employees, leading to more unemployment claims.
C. With the economic downturn, businesses lay off employees, so unemployment claims rise.
D. The economic downturn causes businesses to lay off employees, hence unemployment claims go up.
options: Due to the recent economic downturn, businesses have had to lay off employees, which has led to an increase in unemployment claims.
Because of the economic downturn, businesses laid off employees, leading to more unemployment claims.
With the economic downturn, businesses lay off employees, so unemployment claims rise.
The economic downturn causes businesses to lay off employees, hence unemployment claims go up.
questions.answer: Due to the recent economic downturn, businesses have had to lay off employees, which has led to an increase in unemployment claims.
